Dear [Mrs Mercier](../persons.html#990)
As [Madame Melon](../persons.html#2031) says SHE has not written to you I enclose her note that you may see how the matter stands. I hope she will have a satisfactory answer about the Grand Bienfacteur

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
